summary: A mixed day led by retail sector expansion and Reliance's mega IPO plans. India's apparel market projected to grow 9% CAGR to $146.3 billion by 2029, while Jio Platforms seeks $114 billion valuation in October 21 IPO launch.

bullets.text: India's apparel market projected to reach $146.3 billion by 2029, growing 9% CAGR from $95.7 billion in 2025, driven by rural consumption.
Jio Platforms targets October 21 IPO launch seeking approximately $114 billion valuation, per sources.
RBI's 29-day variable rate reverse repo auction attracted Rs 79,655 crore in bids, fully accepted at 5.49% rate.
VinFast plans to establish over 50 electric two-wheeler showrooms across 34 cities in 15 states and UTs via signed letters of intent.
Delhi High Court upheld denial of visa to Indian-origin US citizen convicted as sex offender.
